title: OpenAI says ChatGPT is catching up to Google in search
slides: Is ChatGPT about to dethrone Google in search?
OpenAI now lets ChatGPT search the live web directly
But it still trails Google on news and shopping queries
Your search habits may shift as ChatGPT improves daily
Test one real query today and compare answers
thread_text:
1. ChatGPT vs Google: The Search War

OpenAI just turned on live web search inside ChatGPT, no plugins required. That puts it directly in Google's lane for the first time.

2. ChatGPT Searches the Live Web

The update fetches current pages in real time, meaning answers can now include today's news. No more relying on a stale training cutoff.

3. Still Weak on News and Shopping

Early tests show ChatGPT lags behind Google on fresh news and product comparisons. It struggles to surface the most recent headlines or the best deals.

4. Your Search Habits May Shift

As ChatGPT gets better at everyday queries, you might start opening it before your browser. Small daily improvements could quietly rewrite your routine.

5. Test One Query Today

Open ChatGPT and Google side by side with a real question you care about. Compare the answers — would you switch based on what you see?
